script_text: Brace yourself, Taurus — this Earth sign, the cosmos rewrites your destiny with fiery precision. Tuesday is your power day because Venus trine Saturn in the 10th House fuels career momentum, while Wednesday is your worst day as Mercury square Saturn creates mental blockages. Focus on practical patience and avoid impulsive spending this week. Follow for daily updates.
